label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy on Player of Year
items.text: Rory McIlroy said there is no clear PGA Tour Player of the Year yet, citing Cam Young, Wyndham Clark, Scottie Scheffler, and Matt Fitzpatrick as contenders depending on criteria.

items.headline: Romero Leads McCormack Medal
items.text: Kiara Romero leads the McCormack Medal for the second consecutive year as top women's amateur and must decide whether to join the LPGA this year or finish her senior year at Oregon.
